opening.offset: meters along wall from its local minimum corner

rules: room dimensions are explicit physical values in meters
an open doorway is a boundary opening, not a second room
the exterior space beyond an opening is not part of the solved acoustic domain
energy leaving through an open boundary is not reflected back into the solved room
openings must remain inside the wall surface that owns them
room geometry changes rebuild the analytical modal basis
the editor must not silently apply the rectangular analytical solver to unsupported arbitrary geometry
reference images remain non-authoritative geometry aids
